parameters.jsCode: const plan=$("Plan one safe RF-01 command").first().json;const closed=plan.gates&&Object.values(plan.gates).every(v=>v===false);return $input.all().filter(i=>i.json.route==="outgoing").map(i=>{const x=i.json;const same=plan.command&&plan.command.kind===x.kind&&plan.command.service_id===x.service_id&&plan.execution_id===x.executionId;const synthetic=plan.integrated_test_authorized===true&&plan.execution_authorized===true&&plan.execution_mode==="manual_test"&&same&&closed&&/^synthetic-ca0[5-8]-[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$/.test(x.service_id)&&plan.coordinator?.baseUrl==="http://host.docker.internal:18787"&&plan.coordinator?.testMode===true&&plan.coordinator?.providerMode==="simulated";return {json:{...x,integratedTest:synthetic}};});

nodes.name: Resolve authoritative service state
nodes.notes: Autodetect body only. HTTP status is authenticated coordinator data; transport failures stop before effects.

parameters.jsCode: const source=(()=>{for(const n of ["Prepare confirmation state","Revalidate and prepare checkpoint"]){try{return $(n).first().json}catch{}}throw new Error("AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_MISSING")})();const raw=$input.first().json;const body=raw&&typeof raw==="object"&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};const version=Number(body.serviceVersion);const projection=body.projection&&typeof body.projection==="object"&&!Array.isArray(body.projection)?body.projection:null;if(body.apiVersion!=="v1"||body.outcome!=="accepted"||body.code!=="STATE_RESOLVED"||!Number.isSafeInteger(version)||version<1||!projection||projection.service_id!==source.service_id)throw new Error("AUTHORITATIVE_STATE_NOT_RESOLVED");const operationRef="rf01:"+source.service_id+":"+source.kind;const confirmation=source.kind==="confirm";const coordinatorRequest=confirmation?{apiVersion:"v1",confirmation:{executionId:source.executionId,serviceId:source.service_id,expectedVersion:version,confirmedAt:source.received_at}}:{apiVersion:"v1",operation:{executionId:source.executionId,serviceId:source.service_id,operationKind:source.kind,operationRef,expectedVersion:version},message:{phoneE164:projection.phone_e164,customerName:projection.customer_name,reviewLink:projection.review_link}};return [{json:{...source,authoritativeVersion:version,operationRef,coordinatorUrl:source.coordinator.baseUrl+(confirmation?"/v1/confirmations":"/v1/operations/outgoing"),coordinatorTimeoutMs:source.coordinator.requestTimeoutMs,coordinatorRequest}}];

nodes.name: RF-01 Coordinator HTTP
nodes.notes: Autodetect body only. 200/409/422 are classified from authenticated coordinator data; transport failures stop closed.

parameters.jsCode: const a=$("Prepare coordinator command").first().json;const raw=$input.first().json;const body=raw&&typeof raw==="object"&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};const version=Number(body.serviceVersion);const safeCode=typeof body.code==="string"&&/^[A-Z0-9_]{1,80}$/.test(body.code)?body.code:"NO_TRUSTED_RESPONSE";const projectionKeys=["service_id","status","request_sent","request_sent_at","review_confirmed","review_confirmed_at","reminder_sent","reminder_sent_at","thanks_sent","thanks_sent_at","completed_at","completion_reason","operation_phase","error_code","updated_at"];const projection=body.projection&&typeof body.projection==="object"&&!Array.isArray(body.projection)?Object.fromEntries(projectionKeys.map(k=>[k,body.projection[k]])):null;const validEnvelope=body.apiVersion==="v1"&&safeCode!=="NO_TRUSTED_RESPONSE";const sameIdentity=validEnvelope&&projection&&projection.service_id===a.service_id;const validVersion=Number.isSafeInteger(version)&&version>0;const newerProjection=sameIdentity&&validVersion&&version>a.authoritativeVersion;const acceptedCode=a.kind==="confirm"?"CONFIRMATION_RECORDED":"PROVIDER_ACCEPTED";const accepted=body.outcome==="accepted"&&safeCode===acceptedCode&&newerProjection;const staleRecovered=body.outcome==="blocked"&&safeCode==="STALE_VERSION"&&newerProjection;const confirmedProjection=sameIdentity&&projection.status==="confirmed"&&projection.review_confirmed===true&&typeof projection.review_confirmed_at==="string"&&!Number.isNaN(Date.parse(projection.review_confirmed_at));const alreadyConfirmedRecovered=body.outcome==="blocked"&&safeCode==="SERVICE_ALREADY_CONFIRMED"&&a.kind==="confirm"&&typeof a.provider_event_id==="string"&&a.provider_event_id.length>0&&validVersion&&version>=a.authoritativeVersion&&confirmedProjection;const recovered=staleRecovered||alreadyConfirmedRecovered;const knownBlocked=validEnvelope&&body.outcome==="blocked"&&["IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_EXISTS","RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE","STALE_VERSION","SERVICE_ALREADY_CONFIRMED","OWNER_MISMATCH","COORDINATOR_UNAVAILABLE","STATE_NOT_DURABLE"].includes(safeCode);const rejected=validEnvelope&&body.outcome==="rejected"&&safeCode==="SEND_REJECTED";const result=accepted?"accepted":recovered?"recovered_projection":knownBlocked?"blocked":rejected?"rejected":"uncertain";const common={kind:a.kind,service_id:a.service_id,provider_event_id:a.provider_event_id??null,operationRef:a.operationRef,send_result:result,coordinator_code:safeCode,serviceVersion:validVersion?version:null};if(a.ca09Test)return [{json:{...common,route:"ca09_test_result",result}}];if(!accepted&&!recovered)return [{json:{...common,route:"blocked"}}];return [{json:{...common,route:a.kind==="confirm"?"confirmation_projection":"outgoing_projection",service:projection}}];
